images.caption: Front of the Moss-Foster House, located at 621 Wayne Street in Sandusky, Ohio, United States.  Built in 1865, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

brief: An island-town cottage lot: Moss-Foster House, a 19th-century Lake Erie house; see the photo for its massing, porch and trim. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: the Lake Erie shore towns that stand in for Victory Bay's island streets (Vermilion, Sandusky, Put-in-Bay) were built 1840-1920, and Commons has almost no newer cottages there. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Moss-Foster House (Sandusky): a white hip-roofed two-storey house, four bays with black shutters, two hipped dormers, a Doric portico with sidelights at one end; a low iron fence and foundation shrubs

why.note: a hip-roofed version of the double-pile house
